title: Sailing on the Mediterranean with Steph and Marcello Bliss
text:
Sailed with the amazing Steph and Marcello on the MonToi.
They were easy to find and welcomed us with smiles and drinks.
Our last full day in Barcelona was made memorable, as we had great weather and watched the Women's Americas Cup races.  Our hosts knowledge and love of sailing made all the difference!  I would highly recommend you book a day with them, worth every penny.

BTW: The boat was fantastic, large, clean, and completely outfitted to offer all the comforts you will need!
author: Sylvia_J

title: Memories on the Mon Toe
text:
We had a wonderful say of sailing on the MonToi.  Steph and Marcello were fabulous hosts.
it was a slow wind day, but they made the day interesting and very enjoyable.  Food and drinks were a bonus.
author: Vitoria_M

title: America's Cup on board. Different. Recommended
text: Amazing experience of living the Copa America aboard the MonToi. An imposing environment and advanced technology that are worth admiring. Also, on board, Estefanía and Marcelo made us feel very comfortable, combining the great comfort of the MonToi with gastronomy according to the occasion and a privileged location on the race court, near the promenade and passing the AC75 next door! Lucky and glad to have gone! Thank you! It was only missing that the victory of Team Prada (Italy) but that no longer depended on the crew!
author: GuidoTGL

title: Brethtaking
text:
Unique, unrepeatable experience. The warmth of Marcelo and Estefi, together with their nautical and culinary knowledge make one have those days when he remembers the beautifulness of living! 
I definitely recommend and will repeat the experience with Navigating Dreams.
Gracias Mont Toi
author: 145ignaciob

title: Super Fun also for non experts! (Super nice and friendly hosts!)
text:
What an Experience….
We searched long to find a cool opportunity to see the americas cup and be on the water 
….and what should I say…
Best choice ever!!!!!!

It was simply so much fun! Marcelo and Estefi were super nice and the boat was incredible! 
Super luxurious and plenty of space. 
I personally was not super into the americas cup before but you don’t have to be an expert to have an insanely fun experience with Marcelo and Estefi on their amazing MonToi :)
Hopefully I find the time to come back soon again!
author: Quest59005159535

title: Incredible hospitality - simply awesome experience!
text:
This was the most amazing experience ever! Absolute highlight from our Barcelona Trip. AMAZING, Hosts, Food, View, Race and general vibe. 
Obviously such a great view on the city and a super cool race but the highlight was definitely the awesome and kind hospitality from Marcelo and Estefi!
If you want to see the Amaris’s cup I can’t think of a better choice!!🤩
author: hannahrJ1287LV

title: Amazing.
text:
My experience with Chelo and Stefi was amazing! Very safe, very helpful and at the same time, very relaxed! In addition, they provide a complete service complementing with onboard screens to watch the broadcast in situations where the detail cannot be understood. 
An unforgettable experience to see the races in the front row!
author: L4006JCignaciov

title: America´s Cup from the best spot
text: Chelo and Estefi are Top-rated captains and hosts. The sailboat is amazing! and they see to it that you are enjoying all the time. They offered us the best views of the race, while they could explain what was happening. They know about the history of the Copa America so it was an enriching and enjoyable experience.
author: K4579QYmariag

title: Attentive and relaxed hosts on a pristine boat!
text: My partner and I spent a day on the water watching one of the preliminary America's Cup races. Estephi & Chelo were so easygoing, we felt so relaxed in their presence. Their boat is pristine (it seems brand new!) and well-equipped. Chelo is a bit of a chef, and Estephi knows a lot about wine, so we ate and drank well and received lots of great info and tips about the area in between races. There was a screen to watch the live stream + they always managed to be in the best location so we got to see multiple team boats fly right in front of us! author: carlygY9944QF

title: Spectacular boat, even better experience.
text: From the moment we got on board Chelo and Estefi made us feel at home. The boat is a beauty, and it really shows with the love that they take care of it. The outing to see the America’s Cup was spectacular, from being able to see the teams leave and prepare, having spectacular views of the boats sailing and racing. They always strived to keep us in the areas with the best views possible, making the experience truly unique and unrepeatable. They also put up a screen to follow the official live broadcast and not miss any details. It was an excellent experience. 100% recommend.
